newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Three Sino-foreign JV firms sign US$30 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Three Sino-foreign JV firms sign US$30 mln loan.

text.p: Three individual equity Sino-foreign joint venture companies in Jilin Province have signed a US$30 million term loan facility, arranger CCIC Finance said on Wednesday.
The borrowers are Jilin Province Xinlong Brewing Co Ltd, Jilin Province Jixin Industry Co Ltd and Yellow Dragon Food Industry Co Ltd.
The deal is guaranteed by Jilin Province Trust and Investment Corporation.
The five-year loans will be used to finance the development costs of the borrowers' underlying agricultural projects, the statement said.

Bank of East Asia's Shanghai branch, CCIC Finance, Kincheng-Tokyo Finance Co Ltd, Nanyang Commercial Bank, Banca di Roma's Shanghai branch, Bank of China's Singapore branch, Development Bank of Singapore's Shanghai branch and Industrial Bank of Japan's Dalian branch participated in the transaction.
